_README: Customizes the launcher UI. Place this file at assets\user_layout.json
(next to user_settings.json). Read once at startup — restart the
Every field is OPTIONAL. Delete any field or the whole block and the
launcher reverts to its built-in default for that item. The values
shown below match the built-ins, so this file as-shipped is a no-op
JSON has no native comment syntax. Keys prefixed with _ (like _README
and _doc_*) are documentation; the launcher ignores them.
visible: false  →  button is HIDDEN. Layout REFLOWS — buttons below
shift up to fill the gap.
enabled: false  →  button is DRAWN (greyed out) and not clickable.
_doc_mod_row_height: Height in logical pixels of each row in the mod list. Default 96.
Smaller values fit more mods on screen without scrolling.
_doc_show_modding_expand: If false, the chevron toggle that opens the bottom modding panel is
hidden and the panel cannot be opened. Use this to lock the launcher
into player-only mode for distributions where you don't want users
_doc_version_label: Position of the 'v1.2' label drawn under the logo on the left rail.
Defaults are computed from the logo's position — if you omit the
version_label block entirely, the label tracks the logo automatically.
Set x/y to override with absolute logical coordinates.

_doc_nav_buttons: Per-button overrides for the six left-rail navigation buttons.
Valid IDs: mods, options, logs, help, about, exit.
Each button has two independent flags:
visible — false hides the button and reflows the column
enabled — false greys the button out (still drawn, not clickable)
